narr: A mid-level shortwave trough moved over a warm, moist airmass and generated thunderstorms. Some of these storms produced locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing Miller Creek Loop Rd. south of Johnson City.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing Low water crossing #30 on McNeil Dr. in northern Austin.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that closed Cameron Rd. at Harris Branch Creek in northeastern Austin.
lsr: Miller Creek Loop road closed due to flooding relayed by Blanco County sheriffs office.
Low water crossing #30 closed at McNeil Drive due to flooding.
Cameron Rd in NE Austin at Harris Branch Creek near Palmer Lane is flooded.
